reality_delta: Kimi raised an evidence-chain concern about whether the final solution plan text and local cross-verification could be independently audited from the provided review package.
main_concern: The review package must provide auditable plan evidence rather than relying only on the main agent's summary.
top_risks: A plan may freeze before reviewers can audit the exact plan text.
A local verification table may be trusted without checking the source text.
The work may continue as plan-level review instead of moving to RSP implementation.
missing_evidence: Auditable plan text or bounded-read bundle metadata.
Cross-verification evidence with section names and required terms.
minimum_fix: Provide auditable verification evidence for the final plan text, or state that the plan cannot be independently verified.

anti_loop_signal.reason: Continuing plan-level review would prolong the loop; use evidence-backed arbitration and then move to implementation.
